_comment: Pinned official sources for the universal !Boot build. sha256 makes the build reproducible even though the URLs serve 'latest'. Re-pin (and re-verify the 3-module merge) when bumping a version.

sources.name: HardDisc4
sources.role: disc-root: !Boot (all ROxxxHook incl. RO370Hook), Apps, Utilities, etc. Bundles its own RO5-era !System at !Boot.Resources.!System.

sources.name: PlingSystem
sources.role: System resources: the disc-based module sets 310/350/360/370/400 that older (26-bit) OSes need. Merged into HardDisc4's !System, newest-version-wins.

sources.name: PackMan
sources.role: Package manager (arm arch = 26/32-bit compatible). Placed in Utilities, not auto-booted.
